family.description: The members of this family are membrane proteins. In some proteins this region is found associated with [pfam:PF02225]. This family corresponds with Merops subfamily A22B, the type example of which is signal peptide peptidase. There is a sequence-similarity relationship with [pfam:PF01080].
family.name: Signal peptide peptidase
